title: The Orchard's Two Resolutions

persistence.store: The existing save event journal; no new save field or global morality score.

canonicalFacts: A rotten water channel failed before the fresh Bramblebuck hoofprints.
The adult Bramblebuck is protecting its young; it is a wild orchard family, not a creature owned by the player.
Both resolutions keep the family safe and the route east open.
openObligations: Mara must finish the repair if the family is moved first.
Rowan should acknowledge the player's choice on the next visit to Amber Ridge.
sharedContinuity.partyBinding: The current player party is unchanged. No starter, owned Bramblebuck, or Brooklet ability is required.

outcomes.decision: Open the shared bypass before moving the family.
outcomes.immediateFeedback: The lower row receives water and the family settles above the waterline; Mara pays 10 coins once.

visibleObjectPrompts.hollow: The family is resting above the flowing row

nextScene.text: Mara's lower row is flowing again; the family is safe. Follow the eastern trail.

outcomes.decision: Guide the family to the dry hollow before the channel is repaired.
outcomes.immediateFeedback: The young reach the dry hollow, the adult follows, and Mara pays 10 coins once; the channel repair remains pending.

visibleObjectPrompts.hollow: The family is safe in the dry hollow

nextScene.text: The young are safe in the dry hollow; the channel still needs repair. Follow the eastern trail.

authoredInterpretation: Existing event keys are canonical facts. committedWhen and nextScene.when are the exact runtime conditions; legacy committedByEvent/conditionEvent keep the stable terminal label. The family rescue objectiveEvent is already a durable family-first commitment before the outcome-label scene is revisited, so prompts, Mara, Rowan and static staging respond immediately to either record. Only reward completion pays; reading/re-entry/import never pays again. Existing adult Bramblebuck and repair boards change nonblocking placements. Terrain geometry, juvenile artwork and family/water animation are not supplied by this handoff.
